findings.title: Removed/renamed helpers from mark_failed can break existing importers and tests
findings.body: This refactor deletes `mark_failed_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context`, and `SimpleCheckIn` from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed`, moving or renaming them into the new modules. No other callers or tests are updated in this PR. Any existing `from sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed import ...` or `mock.patch("sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.mark_failed_threshold")` in tests/plugins will now fail at import or patch time. Search for all old-name references and update them, or leave backwards-compatible aliases before merging.

findings.title: Computed monitor config with schedule_type display is discarded
findings.body: `get_monitor_environment_context` copies the monitor config and replaces `schedule_type` with `get_schedule_type_display()`, but then returns `monitor_environment.monitor.config` instead of the computed local `config`. The local variable is unused, so the occurrence's monitor context always contains the raw schedule_type value instead of the human-readable display value. Return `config` here.
